label: 2007 · First survey: 69% of payments are cash
detail: The Reserve Bank's first Consumer Payments Survey finds 69% of payments are made in cash.

label: 2008 · ATM use peaks at 863 million withdrawals
detail: The most ATM cash withdrawals ever recorded in a single year.
source: RBA Retail Payments Statistics Table C4

label: 2013 · Tapping first measured (8%)
detail: Contactless card payments are measured in the survey for the first time: 8% of payments.

label: 2018 · PayID and fast transfers launch
detail: The New Payments Platform goes live in February 2018 with real-time transfers and PayID.

label: 2019 · Tapping overtakes cash
detail: Tap-with-card payments (42%) pass cash (27%) for the first time.

label: 2020 · Pandemic: ATM use falls 28%
detail: ATM withdrawals fall from 548 million in 2019 to 395 million in 2020.
source: RBA Retail Payments Statistics Table C4

label: 2022 · Cash is 13% of payments
detail: Cash reaches its lowest recorded share of payments.

label: 2023 · Optus outage stops card payments
detail: A nationwide outage on 8 November 2023 interrupts card terminals and banking apps for hours.
source: Senate inquiry into the Optus network outage

label: 2025 · Cash steadies at 15%
detail: The first survey in which the cash share does not fall.

label: 2026 · Law requires shops to take cash
detail: Businesses selling essential goods must accept cash for in-person purchases.
